purpose: Append-only native-only successor that advances exactly one stage beyond the successful v3r13 pre-outcome stop by reserving, writing, readback-verifying, and completing one fixed diagnostic outcome receipt, then stopping before Python, controller, AFES, Blender, body mutation, save, render, or export.

predecessor_truth.v3r13_result: all native pre-outcome gates passed; exact terminal accepted; no Python/controller/outcome/AFES/Blender

allowed: read-only exact-byte verification of fixed v3r14 and v3r13 subjects
CREATE_NEW write-through reservation of one fixed RUN_EVIDENCE.jsonl
CREATE_NEW write-through reservation of one fixed NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_OUTCOME.receipt.bin
exact normalized final-path verification on both newly created file handles
one bounded reservation-record write and same-handle readback
exact byte and stable file-identity comparison
one append-only completion-record write after reservation readback succeeds
whole-file same-handle readback and exact comparison
append-only completion evidence and immediate native return
forbidden: DLL loading or dynamic symbol resolution by application code
Python initialization or Python API calls
save, render, export, activation, assignment, publication, or upload
receipt deletion, replacement, truncation, rewrite, move, or retry

outcome_protocol.reservation: CREATE_NEW plus FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH; any file creation consumes a later one-shot authority regardless of outcome
outcome_protocol.record_1: fixed-size packed reservation record marked RESERVED_PENDING_READBACK and bound to exact executable, audit, v3r13 evidence, retained manifest, random nonce, volume serial, and file ID
outcome_protocol.record_2: fixed-size packed completion record appended only after exact same-handle readback of record 1; marked READBACK_VERIFIED and bound to SHA-256 of record 1
outcome_protocol.final_gate: each newly created handle first proves its exact normalized final path; the same owned receipt handle then reads exactly both records, rejects extra or missing bytes, compares exact bytes, and rechecks stable file identity
outcome_protocol.partial_truth: a reservation-only or partial receipt consumes authority and is failure evidence; it is never retried or called complete

next_stage_if_successful: A separate append-only successor may investigate retained Python initialization and controller/bootstrap entry, still without AFES/Blender mutation, only after this exact receipt succeeds and another fresh audit grants that separate boundary.
truth_limits: Static compilation and tests do not prove runtime outcome reservation.
A later successful v3r14 run would prove only native receipt reservation and exact readback.
It would not prove Python, controller, AFES, Blender, anatomy, movement, or a completed Kira body.
